role: glyph fallback after the template body font
repertoire: All 3,500 tier-one and 3,000 tier-two characters from the 2013 Table of General Standard Chinese Characters, plus 47 fixed UI/name extras, except U+20BB7 which upstream Noto Sans SC does not contain; plus Latin, general punctuation, currency, arrows, CJK punctuation and fullwidth forms. Third-tier/rare names and Traditional Chinese are not promised.
loaderPolicy: Separate lightweight subsets of the same approved family, embedded in each Web loader.
